newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends mixed on Turkey rumors.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends mixed on Turkey rumors.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures ended mixed with nearbys down on local and commission house selling tied to rumors Turkey had tightened phytosanitary requirements, traders said.

"It sounds as if the government is starting some kind of zero-tolerance program," a trader said, adding that the concerns included vomitoxin and TCK smut. "That rumor was certainly up here and may have led to the decline."
Atwood reportedly sold 300,000 bushels March on the close which contributed to the declines, traders said. Wilson Trading was also said to be a seller.
ADM and Continental Grain were noted buyers, traders said.
Floor sources said Turkey had been buying cargoes of U.S. spring wheat on a regular basis and typically ground it into wheat and re-sold it to eastern European countries.
Barley futures did not trade but commercials were offering it at five to 10 cents below the settlement price, traders said.
Wheat ended six cents per bushel higher to 1-1/2 cents lower with December down 1-1/2 at $4.09.
